in_arabic.name: Layzal
in_arabic.long_meaning: Layzal هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word لزل (Lazal) meaning gentle, soft, and beautiful. In nature, it represents the gentle rustling of leaves and the softness of flowers.
